questions.stem: Find the area of a circle with radius 7 cm. (π = 22/7)

options.option_text: 176 cm² (wrong: that would be πr² with r=8 approximately)

questions.explanation: B is correct. Area of circle = πr² = (22/7) × 7² = (22/7) × 49 = 22 × 7 = 154 cm². **Shortcut:** When r = 7, always use π=22/7; the 7s cancel: 22/7 × 49 = 22×7 = 154.

questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 5 cm and height 14 cm. Find its volume. (π = 22/7)

options.option_text: 880 cm³ (wrong: 22/7 × 20 × 14 = 880; would be r=√20, not r=5)

questions.stem: Find the curved surface area of a cone with radius 6 cm and slant height 10 cm. (π = 22/7 approximately, or leave in terms of π)

options.option_text: 60π cm² (correct: CSA of cone = πrl = π×6×10 = 60π cm² ✓)
120π cm² (wrong: 120π = πrl×2 = total surface area without base... no: TSA=πrl+πr²=60π+36π=96π)
36π cm² (wrong: 36π = πr² = area of base only)
96π cm² (wrong: that's the total surface area: πrl+πr²=60π+36π=96π, not CSA)

questions.explanation: A is correct. Curved Surface Area (CSA) of cone = πrl (where r=radius, l=slant height). = π×6×10 = 60π cm². Total Surface Area = πrl+πr² = 60π+36π = 96π cm². Note: slant height l ≠ height h; l = √(r²+h²).

questions.stem: A sphere has radius 6 cm. Find its volume. (π = 22/7)

options.option_text: 288π cm³ (this is in terms of π; numerically ≈904.78; but decimal form is asked)

questions.stem: If the circumference of a circle is 44 cm, find its area. (π = 22/7)
questions.explanation: B is correct. Circumference = 2πr = 44. r = 44/(2×22/7) = 44×7/44 = 7 cm. Area = πr² = (22/7)×49 = 154 cm². **Short Trick:** C=44, C/π gives diameter; diameter=44/(22/7)=44×7/22=14; r=7.

questions.stem: A rectangular room is 15m×12m. A carpet costing ₹15/m² is to be laid. Find the cost.
questions.explanation: B is correct. Area = length × breadth = 15 × 12 = 180 m². Cost = area × rate = 180 × ₹15 = ₹2,700.

questions.stem: Find the total surface area of a cube with side 5 cm.
questions.explanation: B is correct. Cube has 6 equal faces. TSA = 6×a² = 6×5² = 6×25 = 150 cm². Volume = a³ = 125 cm³ (different from TSA). **Formulas:** Cube: TSA=6a²; Volume=a³; Lateral surface area=4a².

questions.stem: A hollow cylinder (pipe) has outer radius 7 cm and inner radius 5 cm, length 10 cm. Find the volume of material in the pipe. (π = 22/7)

options.option_text: 1,100 cm³ (wrong: that's the total volume if solid with outer radius)

questions.stem: A wall of dimensions 6m×5m has a window of 2m×1m. If paint costs ₹20/m², find the cost to paint the wall.

options.option_text: ₹560 (correct: wall area=6×5=30; window area=2×1=2; paintable area=28 m²; cost=28×20=₹560 ✓)

questions.explanation: A is correct. Total wall area = 6×5 = 30 m². Window area (not painted) = 2×1 = 2 m². Net area to paint = 30−2 = 28 m². Cost = 28×₹20 = ₹560.

questions.stem: A sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into a cylinder of radius 4 cm. Find the height of the cylinder.

options.option_text: 9 cm (correct: volume sphere=(4/3)π×216=288π; volume cylinder=π×16×h=288π; h=18 — wait: 16h=288; h=18 cm; not 9)
18 cm (correct: sphere volume=(4/3)π×6³=288π; cylinder volume=π×4²×h=16πh; 16πh=288π; h=18 cm ✓)

questions.explanation: B is correct. Volume sphere = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3)π(6)³ = (4/3)π×216 = 288π cm³. Volume cylinder = πR²h = π(4²)h = 16πh. Equal volumes: 16πh = 288π → h = 288/16 = 18 cm.
